text:
devin: quick heads-up — compact base-image push + runtime syscall hardening tomorrow 21:00 UTC. Need an ephemeral KMS decrypt binding for the staging signer so oncall can verify cosign sigs during the canary. Also want SIEM-forwarded, PI-redacted audit logs and a short RBAC review.

ana: what's the exact window? don't want any long-lived perms.

devin: 45m total (15m prep, 30m canary). Only the single key `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/image/cryptoKeys/staging-signer` should be targetable. Plan: create `sa:image-canary-unseal@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com`, bind `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` on that one key, add the SA to a temporary group, then destroy binding after 45m.

cho: prefer VCS + infra-managed ephemeral resource (terraform) so there's an audit trail and auto-destroy. example snippet i'll add to infra repo:

```
resource "google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding" "canary_decrypt" {
  crypto_key_id = "projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/image/cryptoKeys/staging-signer"
  role          = "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter"
  members       = ["serviceAccount:sa:image-canary-unseal@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]
}
# scheduler job will run:
# terraform destroy -target=google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding.canary_decrypt -auto-approve
```

sec-bot: runbook must include approval gating: PagerDuty ack + 2nd sec approver. Tag the window with `run_id:1788888888` for correlation.

devin: logging requirement: cosign verify outputs should be sent to SIEM with PII redacted. Capture: actor_hash, key_resource, image_digest, cosign_version, run_id.

ana: suggested cosign snippet for runbook (redacts actor by hashing):

```
RUN_ID=run-1788888888
cosign verify --key projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/image/cryptoKeys/staging-signer registry.redwood.ai/base:compact-2026-04-20 --output json \
  | jq '{actor:(.verification[0].signer // "unknown"), key:.key, image:.critical.image.digest, cosign:.cosignVersion}' \
  | jq '.actor = (.actor | @sha256)' \
  | logger -t image-sig-verify
```

cho: vuln triage: grype on base-compact-2026-04-19 -> HIGH:0 MEDIUM:1(libssl) LOW:3. Patch applied in this build. will re-scan image before canary.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-04-20T21:00:00Z — 30m window, 5% traffic to canary pool. Notifying oncall and sec. Runbook link: https://go/runbooks/compact-base-canary.

sec-bot: Audit forward confirmed to `siem:image-audit-redacted`. Retention 18 months. ACLs: sec + infra read raw; devs access redacted indexes only. Events will be tagged `run_id:1788888888`.

devin: post-window assertion: run `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/image/cryptoKeys/staging-signer` and post output to audit index. If the ephemeral binding is still present, auto-open issue and page sec-oncall.

cho: i'll include the terraform plan, scheduler destroy job, and the post-window check in the PR. PR will require PD ack checkbox + sec approver. Also adding a quick rollback path in the runbook (disable canary traffic + redeploy previous image).

ana: ensure the scheduler/destroy job runs with least privilege — only permission to destroy the specific binding and to read the key policy for verification. no broader perms.

sec-bot: also snapshot cosign verify outputs and compute an integrity hash for forensics retention. store hash in `siem:image-hash` index.

devin: thanks — PR filed in infra (link in a minute). ping here when reviewed and when deploy-bot posts the final schedule. :white_check_mark:
